Name: DiploCat
Details: Lion, affectionately known as "DiploCat", is the pride and joy of Burt "St Burt" Onias. His feline diplomacy tactics allowed him to get away with anything. As handsome as he was good natured, Lion knew what he wanted from life; sunny naps, to chase a squirrel or shout at a pigeon, he took every opportunity. A loyal and loving friend, the paws that launched a thousand Bears!
